title: Vanta smp
description: This server is fabric vanilla hardcore server. if you die, your banned for ever ANY pvp is welcome
body: Vanta smp is a hardcore smp where if you die, your banned for ever. server never resets so destory, explore and create. This is a vanilla fabric hardcore server. My server is meant hardcore because I feel people take death to easliy, you die to a skeloten, you can go get your stuff back, but on hardcore, you have to be more cautious. This server Is just base vanilla, render distance and simulation distance is the same so pvp Is much easier. You should join this server because the friends you can make, the builds you can create and in general just have a great experiance
